name: music-composition
description: 27 skills in six layers: workflow and the ARR-SPEC contract; general craft (melody, harmony, progressions, modulation, rhythm, form, counterpoint); arrangement craft (architecture, orchestration including Chinese folk orchestra, texture, rhythm section, sound design, vocal direction, mix intent); eight style layers (J-pop, city pop & R&B, jazz, Mandarin pop, EDM, rock band, cinematic, hip-hop) each with a transfer table and declared fusion ownership; execution (compile to Suno/YuE2/MIDI, symbolic score, AI-tell audit); and a corpus layer of measured recordings. Plain text, no tooling required; answers in the language you ask in
